rule.text: Adopt only when NQ out-of-sample folds AND decide folds improve, NQ total stays positive, NQ 2.0-4.5 trades/week overall and in every fold (a fold already under 2.0 may not lose trades), no more folds worse than better, and ES futures P&L is not hurt. Partly passing -> PROBATION; failing -> RETIRED.
